name: Electron
description: A small rocket for small spacecraft. By far the cheapest ride, but it cannot lift much.

source.title: Rocket Lab, Electron
source.detail: 300 kg to low Earth orbit (Rocket Lab); 200 kg to sun-synchronous orbit (Rocket Lab figure as quoted by Wikipedia). Cost is the publicly stated launch price as reported in the press, not a NASA contract value.

name: Pegasus XL
description: A winged rocket dropped from an aeroplane. It carries small satellites to low orbit.

source.title: Northrop Grumman Pegasus User's Guide
source.detail: Fig. 3-1: 221 kg at 741 km circular, 90 degrees without HAPS. NASA LSP gives low-inclination capacity; NASA ICON release gives launch cost.

name: Falcon 9
description: A large rocket that can lift very heavy spacecraft to low orbit.

source.title: NASA PACE Spacecraft and SpaceX Falcon 9
source.detail: NASA PACE spacecraft facts: 3748 lb fully fueled, about 1700 kg, flown on Falcon 9 to a 676 km sun-synchronous orbit. The game uses this demonstrated reference load. SpaceX lists 22800 kg to LEO and 4020 kg to Mars. Cost is NASA PACE launch contract.

name: Atlas V 401
description: A large rocket that has launched Landsat satellites. It can reach polar orbits with heavy spacecraft, at a high price.

source.title: United Launch Alliance, Atlas V performance; NASA launch services contract release for Landsat 9
source.detail: 401 configuration: 9,800 kg to LEO at 28.7 degrees, 8,080 kg to LEO at 90 degrees. Cost is NASA's total cost to launch Landsat 9.

name: SLS Block 1
description: Sends heavy spacecraft toward the Moon.

source.title: NASA Space Launch System Reference
source.detail: Block 1 sends more than 27 t toward the Moon. The game uses the published lower bound. $2200M is the NASA OIG IG-22-003 p. 23 production estimate for one SLS, excluding Orion and ground systems.

name: Atlas V 541
description: A proven launcher for Mars rovers.

source.title: JPL Mars Science Laboratory Landing Press Kit
source.detail: Quick Facts, p. 6: the Atlas V 541 launched a 3893 kg spacecraft toward Mars. This is a demonstrated lower bound at the Curiosity trajectory, not the maximum. $243M from NASA Mars 2020 launch services award.

name: Saturn V
description: The launcher that sent the Apollo spacecraft and lunar lander toward the Moon.

source.title: NASA What Was the Saturn V?
source.detail: About 43,500 kg toward the Moon. Apollo 15 Press Kit gives a $185M launch-vehicle estimate in 1971 dollars.
